meta.name: Diwali past-events backtest data
meta.scope: Nifty 50 (50 stocks) x 26 past Diwali events (2000-2025) + 2026 calendar

conventions.anchor: Laxmi Pujan / Muhurat date T (hand-corrected list, verified against price data); the Muhurat session itself is NOT a trading day
conventions.offsets: T-1 = last market session before T, T+1 = first after T. PROJECT 8x8 GRID. sessions[] is ordered T-8..T-1, T+1..T+8 (index 0..15). Entry at close of T-N = sessions[8-N]; exit at close of T+M = sessions[7+M]
conventions.grid: long_return_pct_grid[N-1][M-1] (8x8, N and M = 1..8) = LONG % return for entry T-N, exit T+M. null = window invalid that year (stock not listed, >7 days from T, >40 days span, or a >35% daily move)
conventions.calendar: Market day = at least 30% of listed stocks traded volume that day (removes placeholder rows on holidays)
conventions.prices: adj_close drives returns (split/dividend safe); raw_close is the actually quoted close for ledgers; null where the stock has no data that day
conventions.sizing: contract_value_1lot = lot_size x last_close (today); margin = 20% of it; same Rs weight for every year
